$comment: DRAFT — NOT IN FORCE. No act binding this product group is in force: every act the instrument catalog records as reaching it is provisional or anticipated, so this schema is our best reading of an instrument that has not been ratified and its field set may change without a migration path. Structural validation against it is not evidence of compliance, and a passport issued against it may not be representable once the act lands. The go sign is a single edit: set that binding's "status" to "in_force" in crates/dpp-domain/instruments/<id>.json. CI then requires this marker to be removed.
title: Odal Node — Furniture Product Group Data (v1.2.0)
description: Furniture fields per EU ESPR Working Plan 2025-2030. Applicability dates and regulatory status are held in the product group manifest, not here. v1.2.0 removes `mattress` from productType: the working plan selects mattresses as a product group of their own, ranked and dated separately, so they are no longer a furniture category. v1.1.0 is kept for historical immutability and still accepts it.

productType.description: EU furniture product type. Mattresses are their own product group, not a value here.

co2ePerUnitKg.description: Carbon footprint in kg CO2e per product unit.

recycledContentPct.description: Recycled content as a percentage of total weight.

repairabilityScore.description: Repairability score 0.0-10.0 (non-regulatory heuristic, not EN 45554 / EU 2023/1669).

svhcSubstances.description: SVHC substances present above 0.1% w/w per Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH) Art. 33.

disassemblyInstructionsUrl.description: URL to disassembly or deconstruction instructions.
